about:
# <c-34e89e>Editor Physics</c>
Bring real-time <c-34e89e>physics simulation</c> right into the Geometry Dash level editor!

## Usage
1. Select one or multiple objects you want to <c-387fec>apply physics</c> to
2. Click the <c-387fec>toggle physics button</c> in the top menu or press your <c-387fec>customizable keybind</c>
3. The simulation <c-387fec>will start</c>! It will <c-387fec>stop automatically</c> when objects settle, or you can <c-387fec>stop it manually</c> by pressing the button again

## Supported objects
- Solids (Standard blocks)
- Slopes
- Spikes
- Circular objects

## Configuration
- World <c-387fec>gravity strength</c> and <c-387fec>physics refresh rate</c>
- Dynamic objects' <c-387fec>physics parameters</c> (Friction, Bounciness, Damping)
- <c-387fec>Random impulse options</c> to apply a physical force to objects on simulation start
- Toggle button position settings
- Customizable keybind for toggling the simulation

### Support
Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/y8fqT5bP6c) for support & bug reports

# 1.1.0
- Added Random Impulse feature
- Added Mod Settings button to the editor pause menu
- Changed the default gravity value to 12.5
- The toggle physics button now turns cyan during active simulation
- Slightly updated the mod icon

# 1.0.1
- Fixed a minor code mistake (now storing the button inside `EditorUI::m_uiItems` instead of toggling its visibility via hooks on `LevelEditorLayer` playtest methods)

# 1.0.0
- Initial release
